ambient_events: A warning-skull on its stake turns its empty sockets toward you as the wind shifts it.
The air itself has a red cast here, and your skin prickles with a heat that has no source.
description: The Redline itself, the top-left corner of the known world, where a line of rusted stakes and warning-skulls marks the place past which the maps simply stop and the living are simply advised not to. Everything here glows faintly, including, after a while, you.
name: The Redline
